known_limitations: The Commit0 screening record marked FastAPI weak_or_unclear because many docs_src tutorial files are also stripped. This v0.3 candidate intentionally scopes to core FastAPI modules.
FastAPI has a wide import graph. The bootstrap overlay is larger than the overlays for smaller libraries and must be independently reviewed before release.
The currently available local environment lacks dirty_equals and has newer Starlette deprecation behavior, so full path/query/TestClient/OpenAPI scoped tests were not used for final snapshot counts.

Only jsonable_encoder was locally sanity-checked on the complete ref. Public route, dependency-cache, include-router, and response-model probes are labeled for async metrics but require a pinned FastAPI test environment for execution.
This record is not release-ready and should not be used as a formal benchmark instance until the remaining gates are closed.

structure_rationale: FastAPI exposes semantic async dependencies between parameter marker factories, dependency graph solving, APIRoute/FastAPI route registration, and serialization/OpenAPI consumers. Downstream agents can write against stale marker object shapes, route metadata, response field behavior, or jsonable_encoder contracts even when patches merge textually.
